translations.name: RideKC Free & Reduced Fare Program
translations.description: RideKC offers lower bus fares for people who qualify. People ages 6 to 18 and 65 or older may qualify. People with Medicare or disabilities may also qualify. You may also qualify if you get certain benefits, such as SNAP or Medicaid. Children age 5 and younger ride free. Apply online for a reduced-fare pass.
translations.website_description: RideKC fares, reduced-fare prices, and application information
